purpose_context: CI reds are dominated by wall-clock/timing flakes that block correct PRs and erode trust in the signal. This mission turns the manual squad analysis into a repeatable measurement: a script plus a scheduled, artifact-producing workflow that quantifies the false-red rate and per-test timing cost incrementally each week, so the team watches a trend instead of re-deriving it by hand.
purpose_tldr: A weekly, on-demand CI job that reports how much CI red is inactionable flake versus real failure.
